title: How China Is Changing Your Internet | The New York Times
summary: A New York Times video on how China's sheltered internet produced a new breed of apps, centering on WeChat's all-in-one model combining payments, social and services. It suggests American companies are now taking cues from Chinese tech.
why: HN cites it as a concise explanation of why WeChat's super-app model is so dominant and why people worry about copycats.

quote.text: This video from NYT explains it what makes WeChat revolutionary as a platform
